in 2013, Pellé Medical Spa is Manchester’s leading medical spa. contact us Established in 2013, Pellé Medical Spa is Manchester’s leading medical spa . We offer state-of-the-art light-based (photo facials) treatments for hair removal , skin resurfacing, scar reduction, correction of hyperpigmentation, and removal of age spots. We also provide aesthetic treatments, such as microneedling . Pellé also offer the best in facials including the Hydrafacial . HydraFacial helps create a personalized approach for each patient by cleansing, exfoliating, extracting and infusing the skin with serums and ingredients tailored to the patient’s skin needs. The spa also offers beauty solutions using injectables (such as Botox and Dysport) and dermal fillers ( Restylane and Juvéderm ). These services are all performed by highly qualified medical professionals who have years of experience. Pellé also offers Coolsculpting , one of the leading technologies in non-invasive fat reduction. Beyond our medical spa services, Pellé Medical Spa also offers salon services and State of the art Salon with 5 styling chairs, master stylists, eyelash extension technician and microblading/permanent make-up specialist. Whether you need hair services such as a cut, color, or bridal up-do or you’re looking for eyelash extensions and a massage, we can help. Then, there’s our fitness studio, which offers classes and other unique fitness opportunities. Jenn is incredibly knowledgeable & She truly takes the time to understand my skin’s needs, The results speak for themselves. Highly highly recommend! – Mia P. An amazing, professional, and knowledgeable crew of people that are also quite personable. The place is beautiful, and it has such a calming atmosphere. – Lisa L. What a wonderful experience. The bright smile as I walked in the door, the calming music, and calming words as I asked about the service. The explanation as we walked through the treatment. The excitement of the results! Pellé is the place to enjoy the journey to beauty! Thanks to all of you! – Laura M. I had the best experience with the staff at Pelle. I was greeted with smiling faces and immediately felt right at home. Each person asked how I was doing, and if there was anything additional they could do. My nurse was knowledgeable and did not try to upsell me on any additional products, and made me feel very comfortable. I am so glad I chose to start my skin journey with Pellé! – Keri F.
